newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian president swears in new chancellor.
newsitem.headline: Austrian president swears in new chancellor.

text.p: Austrian President Thomas Klestil, performing his first official duty since recovering from severe pneumonia, swore in new Chancellor Viktor Klima and his Social Democratic ministerial team on Tuesday.

The short ceremony, lasting less than an hour, took place against the backdrop of Vienna's historic Hofburg palace. Klima, 49, becomes Austria's eighth chancellor since the Second Republic was founded in 1945.
The former finance minister takes over from outgoing chancellor Franz Vranitzky and will make his maiden speech to parliament on Wednesday.
